markdown_content: # Customize Avatar Bust Cup Size | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive This document explains how to customize the bust cup size of avatars in Clo 2025.0 using the updated avatar editor. It covers navigating the editor, adjusting bust and underbust measurements, selecting cup sizes, and using brush shaping for detailed customization. --- ## Accessing the Avatar Editor and Basic Bust Size Adjustment This section describes how to locate the avatar editor within Clo 2025.0 and perform basic bust size changes using numeric inputs. - To begin editing an avatar, go to the top toolbar and select **Avatar > Avatar Editor**. - The avatar editor window opens, which can be resized by dragging from the center. - Basic bust size adjustment can be done by entering a numeric bust measurement (e.g., 34) into the bust size field. - Changing the numeric bust size directly alters the avatar’s bust, but this size is not automatically maintained if other changes are made. - This manual input method remains available for users preferring direct size entry. --- ## Using Cup Size Settings for Bust Customization This section details how to use the new cup size feature to customize bust shape more precisely by specifying cup sizes and related measurements. - Cup size customization requires selecting the **Underbust** measurement first. - Open the **Set Details** menu by clicking the settings button on the side of the avatar editor window. - Enable the **Cup Size** option to reveal cup size settings. - Cup sizes available are limited to four options: 3, 4, 5, or 6, corresponding to standard cup sizes. - After selecting a cup size, the interface displays size labels such as B, C, D, and double D. - Users can also adjust measurements associated with these sizes, such as bust differences like 5.9, 6.9, 7.9, and 8.9 inches. - These measurements can be customized to match personal standards or reset to Clo’s default standards. - Example adjustments include setting bust difference values to 6, 7, 8, or 9 inches for more pronounced differences. --- ## Finalizing Cup Size and Measurement Settings This section explains how to confirm and exit the cup size adjustment mode and how the measurements reflect on the avatar. - After adjusting cup sizes and measurements, click **Exit** at the top right to finalize changes. - The editor window will revert to the original view, now showing the cup size as **Custom** based on the bust measurement (e.g., 34) and the underbust difference (e.g., 7.9 inches). - The underbust measurement is displayed (e.g., 26 inches), along with the difference between bust and underbust. - Users can toggle cup size labels (e.g., double A, double D) and see real-time measurement differences. - The system continuously shows the difference between the underbust and bust, aiding in precise sizing. --- ## Using Brush Shaping for Detailed Bust Customization This section covers the use of brush shaping tools introduced in a later release, enabling more detailed bust shape manipulation. - The **Brush Shaping** feature allows users to fine-tune the breast shape beyond basic size and cup adjustments. - Access brush shaping within the editor to sculpt the avatar’s bust to better reflect specific anatomical shapes. - This tool complements cup size customization by providing greater control over the avatar’s silhouette. --- ## Enabling, Disabling, and Persistence of Cup Size Settings This section explains how to toggle the cup size feature on or off and how measurements persist across toggling. - The cup size feature can be turned on or off via the settings button in the avatar editor. - Disabling cup size and exiting removes the cup size interface but retains all previously entered measurements. - Reactivating cup size brings back the saved measurements and cup size selections. - This flexibility allows users to switch between numeric bust sizing and cup size adjustment without losing data. --- # Summary Clo 2025.0’s avatar editor now includes enhanced bust customization through numeric bust sizes, standardized cup size options (3 to 6), adjustable measurement differences, and brush shaping tools for detailed modeling. Users can easily toggle cup size settings while preserving their custom measurements, providing a versatile and precise avatar editing experience.
